direction_as_read: Raises blood NAD+ reliably, but clinical primary outcomes are null in cognition and long-COVID, worse than placebo in Parkinson disease, and positive in one peripheral artery disease trial
summary: The labels print nicotinamide riboside hydrogen malate at 415 mg on five labels, nicotinamide riboside chloride at 300 mg on one and nicotinamide riboside at 150 mg on one, with aging, energy or muscle purposes. Blood NAD+ rises with dose (31278280). At 1 g/day and above, cognition primary outcomes were null (42478598, 41357333, 39817194, 37994989), the Parkinson phase 3 favored placebo (42848371), and one peripheral artery disease trial favored nicotinamide riboside on walking (38871717). No trial tested the hydrogen malate salt or measured a longevity outcome at the label amounts.
